basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Manifold Technician, Senior Plumber Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna (AIIMS Patna) is recruiting candidates for 6 vacancies comprising Manifold Technician (Gas Steward) and Senior Plumber posts on a deputation basis. Eligible applicants must submit their offline applications through Speed Post or Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Phulwarisharif, Patna on or before 24 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must send their applications through Speed Post or Registered Post to the following postal address: Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Phulwarisharif, Patna-801507 The envelope containing the application(s) must be superscribed with "Application for the Post of ___________________ on Deputation Basis" .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility and Qualification Details: Manifold Technician (Gas Steward): Officials holding analogous post in Government Organization or holding post with five years of relevant experience in the grade pay of Rs. 2400/-. Essential qualification: 10+2 in Science with 7 years' experience in Medical Gas Pipeline System in a minimum 200 bedded Govt. Hospital; OR Trade Certificate or ITI Diploma in Mechanical Engg. with 5 years' experience in Medical Gas Pipeline System in a minimum 200 bedded Hospital. Senior Plumber: Officers under the Central/State Governments, UT Administration or of Central Statutory/ Autonomous Bodies, Holding analogous post or with 8 years regular service as plumber in the grade Rs. 1900/-. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed proforma through proper channel Duly attested photocopies of up to date Confidential Reports / APAR (at least for the latest 05 years) Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate Comparative chart regarding Pay Scale granted to the official with Central Government pay scale, duly certified by their Finance/Accounts Department (for candidates not following Central Government Pay Scales)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is regulated as per the relevant Recruitment Rules/DoPT instructions. It includes scrutiny of applications, verification of up-to-date Confidential Reports or APAR for the latest 5 years, and receipt of Vigilance Clearance. Maximum age limit is 56 years as on the last date of posting of application. The period of deputation will be for a period of three (3) years and extendable for a maximum period of five years as per DoPT guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna deputation posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of completed applications in the prescribed proforma through proper channel is 24 November 2026, which is within 45 days from the publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying for the aforesaid posts on deputation is 56 years as on the last date of posting of application.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose attested photocopies of their up-to-date Confidential Reports or APAR for the latest 5 years, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate, and the prescribed proforma routed through proper channel.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale for the Senior Plumber post?
faq.answer: The Senior Plumber post carries Pay Level-4 with a pay scale of Rs. 25,500 to 81,100.
